adapter.package_command: make DESTDIR="$pkgdir" install && install -d "$pkgdir/var/lib/dhcpcd" "$pkgdir/var/empty" "$pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/system" "$pkgdir/usr/lib/sysusers.d" && printf '%s\n' '[Unit]' 'Description=DHCP client daemon' 'Wants=network.target' 'Before=network.target' '' '[Service]' 'Type=notify' 'ExecStart=/usr/sbin/dhcpcd --quiet --nobackground' '' '[Install]' 'WantedBy=multi-user.target' > "$pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/system/dhcpcd.service" && printf '%s\n' 'u dhcpcd - "dhcpcd privilege separation" /var/empty /usr/sbin/nologin' > "$pkgdir/usr/lib/sysusers.d/dhcpcd.conf"
